Frequently Asked Questions
TRIAL
How does the free trial work?
keyboard_arrow_down
When you sign up for your trial, you'll have access to all features on the Free Trial plan. If you want to try a specific plan, just contact us. At any point during the trial, you can choose a plan and pay by credit card from within your account.
What happens after the trial ends?
At the end of your trial, your data and setup remains intact. You can login and select a plan to purchase.
GENERAL
What is a credit?
In WeCP, one credit gets consumed when a candidate start or attempt a test.
What resources are available to ensure I'm getting most out of WeCP?
Customers on any WeCP plan have access to online support, as well as the
WeCP Help Center,
on-demand training, and
YouTube Videos
for onboarding and learning. For additional fees, customers can access prescriptive guidance, custom training, hands-on configuration, 24/7 support, and implementation services to ensure teams are set up for success.
Does WeCP integrate with ATS and other applications
WeCP integrates with the world's popular ATS and Productivity tools available in the
Partner's Guide to Integrate with WeCP
. You can also build custom integration with WeCP using our APIs. Please contact your customer success manager.
How do you protect your customer's data?
WeCP combines enterprise-class security features with comprehensive audits of our products, systems, and networks to ensure customer and business data is always protected. WeCP is also ISO, SOC2, GDPR complaint. Take a look at the
security measures
we take to protect your business and your customers.
